text_block_list.text:
I happen to spot Narita Taishin and am
about to
call out to her when she stops
me with a deadly
glare.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Halt! Don't you dare come any closer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I can't deal with noisy dimwits like you
or Ticket
right now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
My head'll split apart if you screech at
me like
you always do!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
One step closer... and I'll seriously punt
you into
space.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: As if! I'll be fine once I rest for a bi—
choice_data_list: 今日のトレーニング、中止するか？
今日のトレーニング、中止する？

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, fine! I'll go to the infirmary! You
happy
now?!
choice_data_list: やっぱり安静にしていた方がいい
やっぱり安静にしていた方がいいよ

text_block_list.text:
She looks at me with the desperation of
a
wounded beast as she stalks off.
